title: VitePress Page Frontmatter
description: Schema for YAML frontmatter in VitePress Markdown pages. Frontmatter allows per-page overrides of site-level and theme-level configuration, as well as page-specific settings like layout, hero content, and feature lists. Frontmatter is defined in the YAML block at the top of a Markdown file between triple-dash delimiters.

title.description: Override the page title. Overrides the site-level title config for this page.

titleTemplate.description: Override the title suffix template for this page. Set to false to disable the title suffix.

description.description: Override the page description meta tag. Overrides the site-level description for this page.

head.description: Additional head tags to inject for this page, appended after site-level head tags.

items.description: A head element tuple: [tag, attributes] or [tag, attributes, innerHTML].

layout.description: The layout template to use for this page. 'doc' applies documentation styles, 'home' enables the landing page layout with hero and features, 'page' is a blank canvas without documentation styles.

navbar.description: Whether to display the navigation bar on this page.

sidebar.description: Whether to display the sidebar navigation on this page.

aside.description: Location of the aside/table-of-contents component. true=right, 'left'=left, false=hidden.

outline.description: Which header levels to display in the page outline. Overrides the themeConfig.outline setting.

lastUpdated.description: Whether to display the last updated timestamp on this page. Can be true/false or a specific date to override the git timestamp.

editLink.description: Whether to display the 'Edit this page' link on this page.

footer.description: Whether to display the footer on this page.

pageClass.description: Add a custom CSS class to the page container element for per-page styling.

hero.description: Hero section configuration. Only applies when layout is 'home'.

features.description: Features section configuration. Only applies when layout is 'home'. Renders a grid of feature cards below the hero.

HeroConfig.description: Configuration for the home page hero section.

name.description: The main name/brand text displayed prominently in the hero. Falls back to the site title if not set.

text.description: The hero tagline displayed below the name.

tagline.description: Additional subtext displayed below the main text.

image.description: An image displayed alongside the hero text. Can be a path string or an object with light/dark variants.

alt.description: Alt text for the hero image.

light.description: Path to the light mode hero image.

dark.description: Path to the dark mode hero image.

actions.description: Call-to-action buttons displayed in the hero section.

HeroAction.description: A call-to-action button in the hero section.

target.description: HTML target attribute for the button link.

rel.description: HTML rel attribute for the button link.

FeatureItem.description: A feature card displayed in the features grid on the home page.

icon.description: An emoji, image path, or object with light/dark image variants for the feature icon.

alt.description: Alt text for the icon image.

light.description: Image path for light mode icon.

dark.description: Image path for dark mode icon.

details.description: Descriptive text for the feature card.

link.description: URL to link to when the feature card is clicked.

linkText.description: Link text displayed at the bottom of the feature card.

rel.description: HTML rel attribute for the feature card link.

target.description: HTML target attribute for the feature card link.
